Running command: python3 << 'PYEOF'
import struct
import zlib

# Read an existing BAM file to understand the format
with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/test/range.bam', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Parse first BGZF block properly
# GZIP header: 10 bytes
# ID1=0x1f, ID2=0x8b, CM=0x08, FLG, MTIME(4), XFL, OS
# Then if FLG & FEXTRA (0x04), XLEN(2) follows
# Then XLEN bytes of extra data
# BGZF subfield: SI1='B', SI2='C', LEN(2), BSIZE(2)

pos = 0
print(f"First 20 bytes hex: {data[:20].hex()}")

# Parse GZIP header
id1, id2, cm, flg = data[pos], data[pos+1], data[pos+2], data[pos+3]
mtime = struct.unpack('<I', data[pos+4:pos+8])[0]
xfl, os_ = data[pos+8], data[pos+9]
print(f"GZIP: id1={id1:02x}, id2={id2:02x}, cm={cm}, flg={flg:02x}, mtime={mtime}, xfl={xfl}, os={os_}")

if flg & 0x04:  # FEXTRA
    xlen = struct.unpack('<H', data[pos+10:pos+12])[0]
    print(f"XLEN: {xlen}")
    extra = data[pos+12:pos+12+xlen]
    print(f"Extra: {extra.hex()}")
    # Find BC subfield
    sub_pos = 0
    while sub_pos < len(extra):
        si1, si2 = extra[sub_pos], extra[sub_pos+1]
        sub_len = struct.unpack('<H', extra[sub_pos+2:sub_pos+4])[0]
        sub_data = extra[sub_pos+4:sub_pos+4+sub_len]
        print(f"  Subfield: SI1={chr(si1)}, SI2={chr(si2)}, LEN={sub_len}, data={sub_data.hex()}")
        if si1 == ord('B') and si2 == ord('C'):
            bsize = struct.unpack('<H', sub_data)[0]
            print(f"  BSIZE: {bsize}")
        sub_pos += 4 + sub_len
    
    compressed_start = pos + 12 + xlen
    compressed_end = pos + bsize - 8  # minus footer (CRC32 + ISIZE)
    print(f"Compressed data: offset {compressed_start} to {compressed_end}")
    
    decompressed = zlib.decompress(data[compressed_start:compressed_end], -15)
    print(f"Decompressed: {len(decompressed)} bytes")
    print(f"First 4 bytes: {decompressed[:4]}")
PYEOF
